title: fix(spec): hook form refusals help names the handler beside the JavaScript body
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9FD3xDgRM1o696UD7FEBAjA)_

Fixes #33803

Clause-②: no — help text only
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：钩子表单「拒绝目录」一行的说明文字，从「仅限 JavaScript (L2) 正文」改为「适用于 JavaScript (L2) 正文或处理器；表达式正文会被拒绝」，并同步 11 个语言包里的同一句（14 个文件，+49/-13）。
- 为什么改：handler 类钩子早已可以声明拒绝目录，表单本身也提供 handler 一行，旧说明会让作者以为 handler 钩子不能用。
- 风险与回滚：纯文字，不改任何行为；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/data/hook.form.ts`（新说明）、`packages/spec/src/data/hook-refusals.test.ts`（末尾新钉子）、`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/zh-CN.metadata-forms.generated.ts` 第 970 行。
- 两分钟验证：`git grep -c "bodies only" -- packages/spec/src/data/hook.form.ts` 预期 0；`git grep -l "For a JavaScript (L2) body or a handler" -- packages` 预期 2 个文件（源与 en 包）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/data/hook.form.ts`: the `refusals` row help now says the code is the one the **hook** throws, and ends "For a JavaScript (L2) body or a handler; refused on an expression body". That is what `HookSchema.refusals` says (`hook.zod.ts`, "a js body or a handler") and what `hookRefusalsWithoutSandboxedBody` refuses (an `expression` body, or neither a body nor a handler). The file docblock says the same.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/*.metadata-forms.generated.ts`: `en` carries the new source string (byte-equal to what `check:i18n` extracts); the ten translated locales (`ar de es-ES fr ja-JP ko pt-BR ru zh-CN zh-Hant`) are re-translated by hand in place, leaf value only, no key added or dropped. No locale has a source-hash entry for this path, so no digest file moves.
- `.changeset/33803-hook-refusals-help-handler.md`: patch for `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/platform-objects`.

## Tests

- New top-level `describe` at the end of `packages/spec/src/data/hook-refusals.test.ts` (the refusals harness file): the `refusals` row help names `handler` and no longer says "bodies only"; the `handler` row it names is a row the same form offers. No forced edit to an existing test. The second commit reads `hookForm.sections` through its optional type (`?? []`), which `check:test-typecheck` asked for; an empty list would still red the `toHaveLength(1)` assertion.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/data/hook-refusals.test.ts src/kernel/repeater-item-titles.test.ts src/system/metadata-form-declared-rows.pin.test.ts`: Test Files 3 passed, Tests 140 passed (head a711ec17; again on final head d4af1df0).
- Ablation (one leg, via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed head): restoring the old ending "JavaScript (L2) bodies only" in `hook.form.ts` landed (anchor 1 → 0, blob 6d2932ce → 8f783593) and turned the new pin red (1 failed / 98 passed); restore proved blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- The nested rows under `refusals` (`message`, `reasons`, `reasons.message`) still say "when the body throws this code". With a handler hook the thrower is the handler, so those three help strings read narrower than the schema. Same wording class, three more strings × 11 locales; left out of this card's scope. carrier: none.

## Verification

All on final head d4af1df0, local subset only; every family CI runs is read from this PR's check-runs.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 84 families from 14 paths vs merge base 385ea1cce; each ran after the last commit and `--ran` reconciled: "84 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 84 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".
- Includes `pnpm check:i18n` (the `en` bundle equals a fresh extract of the new source string), `check:i18n-stale-fill`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:test-source-alias`, and the spec dist family (`check:api-surface`, `check:docs`, `check:authorable-surface`, `check:exported-any`) after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`.
- Environment notes, not findings: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first exited 3 on the shallow clone (pinned fixture commit missing), green after fetching that commit; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, packages without dist), green after building `./packages/**`; the four spec dist gates exited 3 after the second commit moved the src hash, green after rebuilding spec.
